name: Oklahoma
permitAge: 15 if enrolled in an approved driver education course (Service Oklahoma); 16 without driver education. Some secondary sources say 15 1/2.

teen.supervisedHours: 50 hours, including 10 at night (GHSA; 10 night hours also in 47 O.S. 6-105 bill text)
teen.nightLimit: Learner permit: drive only 5 a.m. to 10 p.m. with a licensed driver 21+. Intermediate: no driving 10 p.m. to 5 a.m. except work, school, religious activity, medical emergency, or with a licensed driver 21+ (GHSA and secondary)
teen.passengerLimit: Intermediate: no more than 1 non-family passenger unless a licensed driver 21+ is present (GHSA and secondary)
teen.phone: All drivers: texting on a hand-held device banned since Nov 1, 2015 (primary offense, fine up to $100). Teen phone rule conflicts between sources; left out.

bac.under21: zero tolerance; sources disagree on 0.00 vs 0.02

notes: Written exam: 20 questions (Service Oklahoma learner permit page). Pass mark not on the official page; commercial sites describe an older 50-question, 80 percent test. Left null.
Move Over (47 O.S. 11-314): fine $1,000 first offense, $2,500 after, since Nov 1, 2023 (Bernardo Mills Law).
School bus (News On 6): 4+ lanes with no median, including a center turn lane, both directions stop; with a median, opposite direction may proceed with caution. Statute text not retrieved.
Several 2025-2026 bills propose amending 47 O.S. 6-105; GDL details may have changed.
Handbook PDF URL and Spanish availability not found within the search budget (only third-party copies).
